verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt served (HTTP 200) at rocm.docs.amd.com, the documentation site for the ROCm stack that runs MI325X, so an agent can be pointed at it. The file notes that docs are split across multiple projects, each with its own file. The evidence is only a truncated probe: the .md doc variant returned 404 and there is no independent corroboration of how useful the file is to agents. Missing for 10: markdown/agent-formatted page mirrors, documented contents and coverage of llms.txt across projects, independent hands-on corroboration.
